description: Update metadata on a storyline: title, live status, or start/end/launch dates. Pass at least one field to change.

isLive.description: Whether the storyline is currently live/active

launchDate.description: ISO 8601 launch date, or null to clear it

storylineEndDate.description: ISO 8601 end date for the storyline

storylineStartDate.description: ISO 8601 start date for the storyline

name: storyline_update
